db/sqlite/blob#

SQLite BLOBs read and written in pieces, without loading them whole.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let blob = await OpenedSqliteBlob(origin: db, database: "main", table: "files",
    column: "data", row: 7, writable: false).blob();
let head = await blob.bytes(offset: 0, limit: 16);    // the first 16 bytes
blob.close();

Description#

SQLite BLOBs read and written in pieces, without loading them whole.

A BLOB cannot change size: reads and writes stay within it, 64 KiB at a time.
